output.summary: The user requires a >= 20% year-over-year decrease in safety incidents per 10,000 service miles to authorize Phase-2 expansion. Last year's rate was (38 events / 120,000 miles) * 10,000 = 3.17 incidents/10k miles. This year's rate is (28 events / 135,000 miles) * 10,000 = 2.07 incidents/10k miles. The calculated drop is (3.17 - 2.07) / 3.17 ≈ 34.8%, which exceeds the 20% threshold.
key_claims: Last year's incident rate: 3.17 incidents per 10,000 miles.
This year's incident rate: 2.07 incidents per 10,000 miles.
The calculated year-over-year decrease is approximately 34.8%.
